title: Documenting Large Webtext Corpora: A Case Study on the Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating implicit sentiment bias using multiple-choice stereotype association questions with a QA model, and computing the co-occurrence of ethnicity terms with sentiment-bearing words within the dataset using sentiment lexicons.

Computing Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) between documents containing regular expressions for sexual orientation identities (e.g., lesbian, gay) and their likelihood of being disproportionately excluded by blocklist filtering.
Calculating the Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) of gender identity terms (e.g., trans, non-binary, women) to measure their disproportionate removal rate caused by the dataset's blocklist.

Measuring the disproportionate filtering of documents mentioning religious identities (e.g., Muslim, Christian) using regex frequencies and Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) against the dataset's blocklist.

Using a dialect-aware topic model to estimate the posterior probabilities of documents being written in African American English (AAE) or Hispanic-aligned English to measure the disproportionate removal of minority dialects by blocklist filtering.
